text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby made a sensational debut. At 
the press conference, she declared she 
would definitely meet all the expectations 
voiced by the reporters.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer suggested she could aim for a 
Junior G1 race. However, Daiichi Ruby 
stated that she wanted to focus on 
conditioning her body for the rest of the 
year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer agreed with the proposal to 
adjust her training to peak for the Triple 
Tiara route, and they set their next goal 
as the Fillies' Revue.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just then, KS Miracle came by. Thoughtful 
toward her roommate Daiichi Ruby, she 
seemed to have come to let her know a 
package had arrived.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her target was decided to be the Fillies' 
Revue. However, faced with the brilliant 
Daiichi Ruby, her Trainer felt a slight 
sense of powerlessness.
